sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the major maintenance 
 procedures P1 of Single stage Horizontal Centrifugal Pump, which must be performed 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block or at any troubles 
 occurs.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by 
quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali Al-Lithy
and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam 
Power Station 2x210MW
Technical Specification of these Pumps
Safety Precautions

Isolate the 
circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.

Isolate the 
electrical cable feeding of the motor of this pump.

The pump must 
be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery
valve.

sections.text:
Work
to be Carried Out
Disassembly of the pump:
Be sure the suction and delivery valves are closed.
Open the plug (19) to drain any liquid inside the pump.
Disconnect the motor from foundation and moved it for away the pump.
Pull the pumps coupling by using manual puller.
Take out couplings key (26) from the shaft (10).
Disconnect the cooling water connection (23).

Screw off the nuts (28) to disconnect bearing bracket (5) with lantern
(4) from spiral box (2).

Screw off bolt (27) & (20) to Disconnect foot of bracket (9) from bearing
bracket and foundation.
Take out bearing bracket with lantern from spiral box.
Screws off the nut (14) pull impeller (1) from the shaft.
Take out impellers key (26/1) from shaft (10).
Screw off the nuts (25) and disconnect gland flange (8).
Take out spiral cover (3) from the shaft (10) by hand with turning.
Take out packing and cooling ring (24) from stuffing box.
Pull shaft protection bush (11) from shaft (10).

Take out oil throw ring (13) from shaft (10) and drain oil by open plug
(19).
Screw off bolts (21) to disconnect bearing cover with oil seal.
Screw off safety nut (17).

Hammer the shaft at coupling side by using polyamide hammer. To take out
the shaft with front bearing and without back bearing which will be inside
the bearing bracket.
Pull the front bearing from the shaft by using bearing puller.
Take out back bearing from bearing bracket by hammering.

sections.text: Inspection and renewed of pumps part

Check the impeller (1), packing ring (12) from mechanical wear or
chemical corrosion and renewed if needed.

Check spiral box (2) from pitting or mechanical / chemical wear and
repair it if needed.
Check the shaft protections bush (11) and renewed it if needed.
Check the cooling ring and renewed if needed.
Check the gasket (29) and renewed if needed.
Check the shaft (10) and repair or renewed it if needed.
Check the front and back bearing and renewed it if needed.
Check gasket and oil seal of bearing covers (6) and renewed it if needed.
Check the oil throw rings and renewed it if needed.

sections.text: Assembly of the pump
Clean every part well.
Assembly every part in reverse sequence of disassembly.
After finishing assembly of the pump it must be rotated by hand.

sections.text:
Re-alignment of the pump and motor 
According to MPIS doc # cpl-001-r0
Change the packing of the stuffing box
Clean the surfaces of the stuffing box and shaft well.

Wire the suitable packing size on apart of a shaft with same diameter of the 
pumps shaft.
The number of turns equal to number of rings needed.
Cut all packing rings along shaft by using, sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box with cut turned 180 o, starting at 9 
oclock.
The packing should never be knocked as they may become damage .

Remember that in soft packing there must always be as light leakage of fluid 
from gland .

Do not tightened the gland hard to prevent the rise in temperature of 
stuffing box .

sections.text: Re. Filling the pump by lubricating oil:
Prepare the suitable lubricating oil in a clean bottle.
Open plug (30).

Fill some lubricating oil and turn the pump by hand many times to clean the 
bearing house.
Open plug (19/1) and drain the oil, which used to clean.

Close plug (19/1) again. And filling the pump with oil until 2/3 of oil side 
glass.
